subject: POC workshop and load/benchmark session — scheduling and prep
messages:
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Khan <samir.khan@arcadia.so>, Priya Nambiar <priya.n@arcadia.so>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Subject: POC workshop and load/benchmark session — initial dates

Hi Samir & Priya,

Great to meet you last week. Based on our discovery, we think the fastest path to validate production behavior is a two-part POC: a hands-on workshop (prompt review + routing rules walkthrough) followed by a constrained load/benchmark run to validate throughput and tail-latency SLOs.

Proposed sessions (2 hours each):
- Workshop (prompt + routing + KV/cache review): Tue Aug 3, 10:00–12:00 PT
- Load/Benchmark run (short ramp + 30m steady state): Thu Aug 5, 09:00–11:00 PT

Can you confirm availability for those windows? If not, send 2 alternative windows next week and we'll coordinate.

I'll include Connor (serving runtime) and Laura (CS/ops) on scheduling and prep. We plan to share a short agenda and a load harness config beforehand.

Thanks,
Soojin

--
Soojin Lee
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0143

Attachments: none in this message

From: Samir Khan <samir.khan@arcadia.so>

Subject: Re: POC workshop and load/benchmark session — initial dates

Thanks, Soojin. Those windows look broadly good. Quick notes:
- Priya and I are both available Aug 3 at 10:00 PT.
- For the load run Aug 5, our infra lead (cc'd privately) has a conflict 09:00–10:00 PT; 10:30–12:30 PT would also work for us.

Could we move the load test to Thu Aug 5, 10:30–12:30 PT instead? If that impacts your ability to run a 2-hour steady-state, let us know.

Also, we'd like to review a quick test plan before the workshop so we can confirm the throughput targets and acceptable latency bands.

Best,
Samir

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
Subject: RE: POC workshop and load/benchmark session — initial dates

Hi all,

10:30–12:30 PT on Thu Aug 5 works for me (I can shift other runs). I'd like to propose a slight tweak to the load plan so we get useful signal in 90 minutes:

Proposed load slot (90–120m):
- 10:30–10:40 ramp (gentle)
- 10:40–11:40 steady-state at target TPS (we should confirm TPS below)
- 11:40–11:50 ramp down + quick artifact collection

Please confirm the throughput target you want us to hit. From our discovery notes, two candidate targets are:
- 50 TPS — matches Arcadia's peak producer path
- 100 TPS — stress target to see latency tail behavior and quantization effects

Connor
(Will attach load harness config and quick checklist before the workshop)

--
Connor O'Brien
Senior Backend Engineer, Serving Runtime
connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 10:35:00 -0700
From: Priya Nambiar <priya.n@arcadia.so>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Samir Khan <samir.khan@arcadia.so>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Subject: Re: POC workshop and load/benchmark session — initial dates

Connor — thanks for the plan. Arcadia recommends we validate both 50 TPS (baseline) and 100 TPS (peak) but only maintain steady-state at one level to conserve credits. Proposal: do two short steady-state windows back-to-back (25m each) at 50 TPS then 100 TPS. Total steady-state ≈ 50m within the 90m window. That should give you enough traces for p95/p99.

We'll bring our infra lead on the call and provide SSH access to a small generator cluster. I'll upload our test accounts to the shared Drive.

Priya
Senior SRE, Arcadia Software
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 08:10:00 -0700
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Khan <samir.khan@arcadia.so>, Priya Nambiar <priya.n@arcadia.so>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
Subject: Updated agenda, artifacts, and calendar invite (workshop + load run)

Folks —

Thanks for the quick replies and the TPS guidance. Attached are the materials we'll use for the workshop and the harness config for the load run:
- redwood_poc_agenda_v1.pdf — workshop agenda, roles, and checklist
- load-harness-config.yaml — harness + generator SSH instructions
- prompt-review-notes.md — examples we'll walk through

Key decisions reflected:
- Workshop: Tue Aug 3, 10:00–12:00 PT (prompt review, routing, KV/cache)
- Load run: Thu Aug 5, 10:30–12:00 PT (10:30–10:40 ramp; 10:40–10:55 steady @50 TPS; 10:55–11:20 steady @100 TPS; 11:20–11:30 ramp down/collection)
- Primary metrics: p50/p95/p99 latency, GPU utilization, tokens/sec, and failure rate per route

I've sent calendar invites to the external addresses with the Drive folder link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-arcadia-poc. Please accept when convenient.

Connor & Rafael: can you double-check the harness config (attached) and confirm we have the right generator SSH key and subnet? If you make changes, push to the Drive and ping Priya.

Thanks,
Soojin

Attachments: redwood_poc_agenda_v1.pdf (application/pdf), load-harness-config.yaml (text/yaml), prompt-review-notes.md (text/markdown)

Soojin — thanks for the materials. We accepted the invites. One small request: our procurement team needs a 1-line summary of what will be executed during the load run for billing (approx runtime and expected GPU-hours). Can someone send that by Thursday morning?

Also, Priya informed me our infra lead may have to dial out 11:00–11:10 for a datacenter operational window. That's fine as long as we keep the two steady-state windows. See you both next week.

Samir
